sentences.quote: Lane Riggs became Chief Executive Officer and President, and a member of the Board, each effective as of the close of business on June 30, 2023 and was elected to the additional position of Chairman of the Board, effective as of the close of business on December 31, 2024.
sentences.text: R. Lane Riggs became chief executive officer and president of Valero Energy Corporation and a member of its board effective at the close of business on June 30, 2023, and was elected to the additional position of chairman of the board effective at the close of business on December 31, 2024.

He previously served as president and chief operating officer from January 23, 2020, executive vice president and chief operating officer from January 1, 2018, executive vice president of refining operations and engineering from 2014, and senior vice president of refining operations from 2011.

Riggs has been with Valero since 1989, beginning as a process engineer at the McKee refinery before holding roles including director of supply and optimization, vice president of refinery planning and economics, and senior vice president of crude, feedstock supply and trading.
